user.title: Mantica school diary
user.description: Enter the school diary address and the parent/guardian login and password.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The diary rejected the login several times in a row. Enter the current password. If it has not changed, the login page may have changed.

layout_changed.title: Mantica diary: page layout changed
layout_changed.description:
Login works, but the page structure is not recognised: {details}

Entities are unavailable to avoid showing wrong data. parser.py needs an update.

site_unreachable.title: Mantica diary: unreachable for a while
site_unreachable.description:
The last {count} attempts failed: {details}

Possibly maintenance, a network issue or a site change. The integration keeps retrying; this disappears after the next successful update.

unknown_message_icon.title: Mantica diary: unknown message state
unknown_message_icon.description:
Read/unread state not recognised (unknown icon): {details}

These messages are not counted as unread. parser.py needs the icon added.

init.title: When to read the diary
init.description: The integration logs in every given number of minutes, only within the given hours (HA local time). Outside them it does not connect at all; the first morning read is at the start hour.

error.bad_hours: The end hour must be later than the start hour.
